findings.desc: CHK-004:edge verificationIntent is not covered by the focused tests. The intent requires proving generated-token persistence is scoped by project root, host provider, and adapter session boundary so different sessions do not collide. The smoke test only asserts same-provider/same-boundary reuse across ppid changes (story-owner-lease-smoke.ts:169-178) and runtime artifact registration (story-owner-lease-smoke.ts:404-420). It never asserts different project roots, different providers, or different adapter boundaries produce distinct token files/session ids, even though owner-session-token-store.ts keys token files by projectRoot/provider/boundary.
